verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere runs models locally through its CLI and on-device SDKs, so a local-serving concurrency limit is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence documents a maximum number of concurrent requests or connections, or any point where throughput degrades. The only throughput figures are community tok/s benchmarks, and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint described is the hosted Wally cloud API, which says nothing about local concurrency.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented maximum concurrent requests or connections the local server can handle before throughput degrades
